Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Contempt Case No.967 Of 2023
Order :
(ORAL) This contempt case is filed by the petitioner seeking to punish the respondents in wilfully disobeying the order dated 16.08.2022 passed by this Court in W.P. No.1530 of 2016.

2. Mr. Zeeshan Adnan Mahmood, learned counsel for the petitioner, submitted that the cause in this contempt case does not survive for further adjudication as the compensation towards acquisition of land of the petitioner has been awarded and an amount of Rs.56,28,557/- (Rupees fifty six lakhs twenty eight thousand five hundred and fifty seven only) has been deposited in the bank account of the petitioner vide cheque bearing No.079927 dated 02.01.2025.

Learned counsel requested this Court to grant liberty to the petitioner to file application under Section 73(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for enhancement/re-determination of the compensation amount.
